_README: Version-controlled suppression BASELINE for the code-health / dream finding pipeline.
An entry here says: the scanner is WRONG about this, and here is why. It is not a
backlog, a deferral, or a 'wontfix' — those belong in the issue tracker, and
acceptance-feedback.sh writes those automatically into the MUTABLE state file at
~/.whisky-os-state/findings-suppressions.json. Both files are unioned at load.
KEY ON `file` + `symbol`. Titles are written by the LLM pass and get reworded
between runs — on 2026-08-18 'generateSectionPalette() is 104 lines' became
'generateSectionPalette() — 104 lines' and a reviewed suppression silently lapsed.
But `file` ALONE is too blunt: it swallowed an unreviewed 'GET() nesting depth 6'
that merely shared a route file with a reviewed POST() finding. `symbol` narrows it
to the thing actually reviewed, and function names do not drift like prose.
Omit `symbol` only when the WHOLE file is intentionally exempt for that class.
Every entry MUST carry a _comment with the evidence that it is a false positive.
Suppressing a real defect is strictly worse than leaving it in the count.

suppress.title: POST() flagged at 37 branches is mostly '|| null' field-fallback mapping, not real control flow
suppress._comment: Verified 2026-08-18 at src/app/api/clients/route.ts:65 — 23 of the counted branches are '|| null' / ternary field fallbacks inside a single prisma.client.create data object. Input is already Zod-validated upstream, so there is no control flow to factor out. Splitting the object would add indirection and remove nothing.

suppress.title: GET()/ReadableStream executor nesting is intentional SSE keep-alive design, not accidental complexity
suppress._comment: Verified 2026-08-18 at src/app/api/sse/route.ts:27 — the nesting IS the SSE protocol shape: a ReadableStream start() executor holding a send() closure over `closed`, the `retry: 30000` directive that stops EventSource storm-reconnects from exhausting the Neon pool, and the poll timer. Flattening it would break the closure that guards writes after close.

suppress.title: generateSectionPalette() is 104 lines
suppress._comment: Verified 2026-08-18 at packages/shared/src/utils/color.ts:728 — flagged on length alone: the function has only 9 branches, and its body is a documented 4-case switch acting as a palette lookup table (the pattern/section matrix is spelled out in a comment table directly above it). Splitting a lookup table across files scatters something that reads correctly as a unit.
